intermediate.name: Ectoderm / Neuroectoderm

intermediate.name: Anterior neuroectoderm (forebrain default)

organoid.name: Cortical organoid (LBD model)
organoid.exposure: STEMdiff cortical kit (SMADi embedded)
organoid.reference: Jin et al., Sci Adv 2024 (cortical organoids, SNCA-triplication Lewy body disease), doi:10.1126/sciadv.adk3700

organoid.name: Forebrain cerebral organoid
organoid.exposure: STEMdiff neural induction medium (SMADi embedded)
organoid.reference: Anastasaki et al., STAR Protoc 2022, doi:10.1016/j.xpro.2022.101173

organoid.name: Cortical organoid (oRG-enriched)
organoid.reference: Luongo & Studer, STAR Protoc 2024, doi:10.1016/j.xpro.2024.103280

intermediate.name: Hypothalamic neuroectoderm

organoid.name: Hypothalamic arcuate organoid (ARCO)

organoid.reference: Huang et al., Cell Stem Cell 2021, doi:10.1016/j.stem.2021.04.006

organoid.name: Cerebellar organoid
organoid.exposure: Noggin + SB431542 + CHIR99021, then FGF8
organoid.reference: Atamian et al., Nat Protoc 2025, doi:10.1038/s41596-024-01093-w

organoid.name: Brainstem organoid
organoid.exposure: Dorsomorphin + SB431542
organoid.reference: Eura et al., Front Neurosci 2020, doi:10.3389/fnins.2020.00538

intermediate.name: Retinal neuroepithelium
intermediate.exposure: SB431542 (+ SAG or LDN193189), then timed BMP4

organoid.name: Retinal organoid (3D, SFEBq)
organoid.exposure: SB431542 + SAG, then BMP4
organoid.reference: Watari et al. (Kuwahara senior author), Commun Biol 6:164, 2023, doi:10.1038/s42003-023-04543-5

organoid.name: Retinal organoid (rapid 90-day)

organoid.reference: Matsushita et al., PLoS ONE 2024, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0308743

organoid.name: Skin + hair organoid
organoid.exposure: SB431542 + BMP4 (surface), with parallel LDN193189 + bFGF (neural crest for dermis)
organoid.reference: Lee & Koehler, Nat Protoc 2022, doi:10.1038/s41596-022-00681-y

intermediate.name: Cranial neural crest
intermediate.exposure: Brief dual SMAD inhibition (LDN193189 + SB431542, 1 day), then Wnt (CHIR99021) alone

organoid.name: Craniofacial cartilage (chondrocytes)
organoid.exposure: CHIR99021 -> cranial NCC -> chondrogenic medium
organoid.reference: Avabhrath & Grimes, STAR Protoc 2025, doi:10.1016/j.xpro.2024.103532

organoid.name: Kidney organoid
organoid.exposure: FGF9 + heparin (Takasato cascade)
organoid.reference: Takasato et al., Nat Protoc 2016, doi:10.1038/nprot.2016.098

organoid.name: Kidney organoid (ARPKD-on-chip)
organoid.exposure: FGF9 + heparin (Takasato/Morizane route)
organoid.reference: Hiratsuka et al., Sci Adv 2022, doi:10.1126/sciadv.abq0866

organoid.name: Ureteric bud / collecting duct
organoid.exposure: FGF9, then GDNF + TTNPB
organoid.reference: Ryosaka, Mae & Osafune, STAR Protoc 2022 (ureteric bud organoids), doi:10.1016/j.xpro.2022.101484

organoid.name: Sertoli-like cells + testis-like organoid
organoid.exposure: PGD2 (500 ng/mL; SRY-independent SOX9 activation)
organoid.reference: Knarston, Combes & Sinclair, Stem Cell Reports 2020, doi:10.1016/j.stemcr.2020.10.009

organoid.name: Testicular organoid (Sertoli + Leydig)
organoid.exposure: FGF9 + BMP4 + heparin, then hanging-drop + rotational niche (EGF/FSH/LH/IGF-1/RA)
organoid.reference: Yao & Huang, Theranostics 2025, doi:10.7150/thno.104523

organoid.name: Endometrial stromal fibroblasts (HOXA10+/PGR+); decidualization
organoid.exposure: 5-aza-2'-deoxycytidine + CHIR99021 + 17beta-estradiol + FGF9 + PDGF-BB, then E2 + MPA + 8-Br-cAMP

organoid.name: Mullerian duct-like cells -> endometrial organoid (epithelial + stromal)
organoid.exposure: CHIR99021 (3 uM; WNT/beta-catenin -> Mullerian vs mesonephric), then Matrigel 3D
organoid.reference: Gong & Zou, npj Regen Med 2022, doi:10.1038/s41536-022-00263-2

organoid.name: Intermediate mesoderm cells
organoid.exposure: BMP4 (low) + CHIR99021
organoid.reference: Magro-Lopez et al., Front Cell Dev Biol 2024, doi:10.3389/fcell.2024.1395723

organoid.name: Cardioid (heart organoid)
organoid.exposure: Wnt inhibitor C59 (after BMP4 + Activin A + CHIR)
organoid.reference: Hofbauer et al., Cell 2021, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2021.04.034

organoid.name: Self-assembling heart organoid
organoid.exposure: CHIR + BMP4 + Activin A, then C59
organoid.reference: Lewis-Israeli & Aguirre, Nat Commun 2021, doi:10.1038/s41467-021-25329-5

organoid.name: Bone marrow organoid (blood/marrow)
organoid.exposure: BMP4 + VEGF -> HE
organoid.reference: Frenz-Wiessner et al., Nat Methods 2024, doi:10.1038/s41592-024-02172-2

organoid.name: Skeletal muscle organoid (dermomyotome)
organoid.exposure: FGF, retinoic acid, SHH, Wnt1a
organoid.reference: Mavrommatis et al., eLife 2023, doi:10.7554/eLife.87081

intermediate.name: Definitive endoderm (SOX17+/FOXA2+)
intermediate.exposure: High Activin A (+/- one-day CHIR99021/Wnt3a pulse)

organoid.name: Definitive endoderm spheroids (terminal)
organoid.exposure: Activin A only
organoid.reference: Bogacheva et al., Front Cell Dev Biol 2021, doi:10.3389/fcell.2021.726499

organoid.name: Lung / airway organoid (respiratory)
organoid.exposure: SB431542 + Noggin + CHIR + SAG + FGF4 (AFE), then FGF10
organoid.reference: Miller & Spence, Nat Protoc 2019, doi:10.1038/s41596-018-0104-8

organoid.name: Alveolus-on-chip
organoid.exposure: Dorsomorphin + SB (AFE), then BMP4 + CHIR + RA (vAFE), then KGF + FGF10
organoid.reference: Luk et al., Sci Adv 2026 (autologous iPSC alveolus-on-chip), doi:10.1126/sciadv.aea9874

organoid.name: Hepatic organoid (iHO)
organoid.exposure: FGF2 + BMP4, then HGF/OSM/Dex, then bile-acid/FXR
organoid.reference: Shimizu et al., Cell Rep 2025, doi:10.1016/j.celrep.2025.115675

organoid.name: Liver organoid
organoid.exposure: Activin A + CHIR, then BMP7, then hepatic/differentiation medium
organoid.reference: Mun et al., Sci Rep 2023 (expandable liver organoids), doi:10.1038/s41598-023-50250-w

organoid.name: Fused liver buds
organoid.exposure: Activin A + Wnt3a, then BMP4 + FGF2, then HGF/OSM/Dex
organoid.reference: Tadokoro et al., Sci Transl Med 2024, doi:10.1126/scitranslmed.adg0338

organoid.name: Multicellular liver organoid (HLO)
organoid.exposure: Activin A + BMP4, then CHIR + FGF4, then RA, then HGF/OSM/Dex
organoid.reference: Maepa et al., Bio-protocol 2024, doi:10.21769/BioProtoc.5042

organoid.name: Cholangiocyte / biliary organoid
organoid.exposure: Activin A + LY294002 + CHIR, then bFGF, then Notch + FGF10 + RA
organoid.reference: Budi et al., Front Cell Dev Biol 2024, doi:10.3389/fcell.2024.1361084

organoid.name: Pancreatic SC-beta cells
organoid.exposure: Activin A + CHIR -> KGF -> LDN + cyclopamine + RA -> endocrine
organoid.reference: Pagliuca & Melton, Cell 2014, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2014.09.040

organoid.name: Pancreatic beta cells (expandable PP)
organoid.exposure: Activin A + Wnt3a -> SANT-1 + RA + LDN -> beta
organoid.reference: Ma et al., Sci Adv 2022 (expandable pancreatic progenitor-derived beta cells), doi:10.1126/sciadv.abk1826

organoid.name: SC-islet
organoid.exposure: Activin A + CHIR -> SANT-1 + RA + LDN -> islet
organoid.reference: Rajaei et al., Sci Transl Med 2025, doi:10.1126/scitranslmed.adl4390

organoid.name: Intestinal organoid (mesenchyme-free)
organoid.exposure: KGF / EGF / Noggin
organoid.reference: Mithal & Mostoslavsky, Nat Commun 2020, doi:10.1038/s41467-019-13916-6

intermediate.name: iMeLC (incipient mesoderm-like; T+/EOMES+, PGC-competent)

intermediate.name: hPGCLCs (SOX17+/BLIMP1+/TFAP2C+)

organoid.name: Oogonia in xenogeneic reconstituted ovaries (DAZL+/DDX4+/SYCP3+)
organoid.exposure: Co-aggregation with mouse E12.5 ovarian somatic cells; air-liquid interface, ~4 months

organoid.name: Oogonia in all-human ovaroid
organoid.exposure: Co-aggregation with iPSC-derived granulosa-like cells (all-human niche); air-liquid interface
organoid.reference: Pierson Smela, Kramme & Church, eLife 2023, doi:10.7554/eLife.83291

organoid.name: Cerebral organoid (unguided whole-brain)
organoid.exposure: OUTLIER: no SMAD inhibition; pluripotency withdrawal + low-N2 medium + Matrigel + spinning bioreactor
organoid.reference: Lancaster & Knoblich, Nat Protoc 2014, doi:10.1038/nprot.2014.158

organoid.name: Cortical organoid (simplified)
organoid.exposure: OUTLIER: spontaneous neural induction in NIM; no SB/LDN/CHIR/BMP
organoid.reference: Eigenhuis et al., Front Cell Neurosci 2023, doi:10.3389/fncel.2023.1114420

organoid.name: Integumentary organ system (skin + hair)
organoid.exposure: OUTLIER: clustered embryoid bodies + Wnt10b + in-vivo subrenal-capsule self-organization
organoid.reference: Takagi et al., Sci Adv 2016, doi:10.1126/sciadv.1500887

organoid.name: Renal tubular organoid
organoid.exposure: OUTLIER: single brief CHIR99021 (6 uM) pulse into maturation medium; no FGF9/heparin IM step
organoid.reference: Facioli et al., PLoS ONE 2021, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0252156

organoid.name: Vascular endothelium (arm of vascularized retinal organoid)
organoid.exposure: BMP4 (30 ng/mL) + CHIR99021 (12 µM) -> VEGF-A + FGF2
organoid.reference: Chen et al., Sci Adv 2025 (vascularized retinal organoids with microglia), doi:10.1126/sciadv.ady6410

organoid.name: Cardio-pulmonary organoid (heart + lung)
organoid.exposure: OUTLIER: single CHIR99021 (7 uM) pulse co-induces mesoderm AND endoderm, then segregate
organoid.reference: Ng & Ren, eLife 2022, doi:10.7554/eLife.67872

organoid.name: Granulosa-like cells -> all-human ovaroid
organoid.exposure: OUTLIER: brief CHIR prime, then NR5A1 + RUNX1/RUNX2 transcription-factor overexpression (dox-inducible); bypasses FGF9/BMP4/PGD2 cascade
organoid.reference: Pierson Smela, Kramme & Church, eLife 2023, doi:10.7554/eLife.83291

organoid.name: Sertoli-like cells + tubules (DSD model)
organoid.exposure: OUTLIER: IM via growth factors (Activin/bFGF -> BMP4 + RA + Activin), then NR5A1 + DMRT1 transcription-factor overexpression instead of PGD2/SOX9
organoid.reference: Gonen et al., Sci Adv 2023 (in vitro reprogramming to model gonad development / DSD), doi:10.1126/sciadv.abn9793

organoid.name: Gonad / testicular somatic organoid (bioreactor)
organoid.exposure: OUTLIER (also hESC H1, not iPSC): Takasato-style IM base, then BMP4 + SHH (then hCG/PMSG); not the FGF9 + low-BMP4 -> PGD2 consensus
organoid.reference: Pryzhkova, Boers & Jordan, Tissue Eng Regen Med 2022, doi:10.1007/s13770-022-00492-y

organoid.name: T cells via artificial thymic organoid (CAR-T)
organoid.exposure: DLL4 / Notch signaling (after HE)
organoid.reference: Wang et al., Cell Stem Cell 2022, doi:10.1016/j.stem.2022.02.009

organoid.name: Airway organoid (ciliopathy)
organoid.exposure: Activin A + CHIR, then Noggin + SB (AFE), then FGF2 + EGF
organoid.reference: Sone et al., Sci Transl Med 2021 (ciliopathy airway-on-chip), doi:10.1126/scitranslmed.abb1298
